speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)

The combination of significant lymphocytosis with characteristic "smudge cells" on the smear, elevated LDH (often seen in active disease, though your specific result said normal, the presence of smudge cells is pathognomonic for CLL), and your symptoms of fatigue and weight loss strongly supports this diagnosis. The normal ESR is atypical but does not rule it out; the smudge cells are the key finding here.
